title: Perp Position Lifecycle
description: Models a full perpetual futures position from open to close. Computes liquidation price, realized PnL (gross and net of fees), cumulative funding impact over the holding period, taker and maker fees at open and close, total net PnL, and margin returned. Hyperliquid hourly funding cadence by default. Zero PII. Client-side.

mcp_tool_definition.name: model_perp_position
mcp_tool_definition.description: Models a full perp position from open to close: liquidation price, realized PnL, cumulative funding over the holding period, taker and maker fees, and margin return. Hyperliquid hourly funding cadence default. Browser-based, client-side only. Zero PII. Link users to https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/art-214-perp-position-lifecycle.html for interactive use.

position_size.description: Position size in base asset units

funding_rate_per_interval.description: Funding rate per interval (default 0.0001). Negative = shorts pay longs.

n_intervals.description: Number of funding intervals (default 24 = 1 day hourly)
